usage: Used to control blood sugar levels in Type 2 diabetes patients.
dosage: One tablet daily with breakfast or as directed. Consult a physician.
warnings: Strictly follow diet and exercise along with medication.
storage: Keep in a cool and dry place.

usage: Combination medicine for blood sugar control in Type 2 diabetes.
dosage: One tablet twice daily with meals. Follow doctor's prescription.
warnings: Inform doctor of any history of pancreatitis.

usage: Triple combination for controlling high blood sugar when single/dual drugs aren't sufficient.
dosage: Usually one tablet before or with meals. Consult a physician.
warnings: Risk of low blood sugar; always keep sugar source handy.

usage: Used for treatment of Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
dosage: One tablet daily with or after food. Seek professional advice.
warnings: Not for use in Type 1 diabetes.

usage: Treats hypertension (high blood pressure) and prevents angina (chest pain).
dosage: One tablet daily at the same time. Consult a healthcare professional.
warnings: Do not stop taking without consulting doctor.
May cause dizziness; use caution while driving.

usage: Used for managing high blood pressure and chest pain.
dosage: One tablet daily as prescribed. Consult a physician.

usage: Treats high blood pressure and reduces risk of heart failure.
dosage: Follow doctor's prescription carefully. Usually once daily.
warnings: Inform doctor if you develop persistent dry cough.
Monitor kidney function and potassium levels.

usage: Lowers bad cholesterol and protects against heart disease.
dosage: One tablet daily, preferably in the evening. Consult a professional.

usage: Antiplatelet drug used to prevent blood clots in patients with heart issues.
dosage: One tablet daily or as prescribed. Consult your physician.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Used to prevent heart attack and stroke by thinning the blood.
dosage: One tablet daily at a fixed time. Follow doctor's guidance.
warnings: Caution if you have bleeding disorders.

usage: Relieves moderate to severe pain like post-operative pain or acute injury pain.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet every 4-6 hours. Max 8 tablets per day. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Do not drive after use due to sedation.
storage: Keep out of reach of children.

usage: Strong painkiller used for moderate to severe physical pain.
dosage: As directed by physician. Usually not for long-term use. Consult a professional.
warnings: May cause physical and mental dependence.

usage: Reduces pain and swelling in bone and joint conditions.
dosage: One tablet twice daily after food. Seek physician's guidance.
warnings: Caution in kidney or heart disease patients.
Do not use in patients with active ulcers.

usage: Used to reduce inflammation and promote healing after surgery or injury.
dosage: Usually 1 tablet thrice daily on an empty stomach. Consult your doctor.

usage: Used for neuropathic pain and as an add-on treatment for seizures.
dosage: Follow doctor's titration schedule carefully. Consult a professional.
warnings: Do not stop suddenly to avoid seizure risk.

usage: Treats GERD, acid reflux, and associated nausea/vomiting.
dosage: One capsule daily before breakfast. Seek professional advice.

usage: Inhibits acid production in the stomach for ulcer healing.
dosage: One tablet daily before meals. Consult a physician.
warnings: Report signs of severe diarrhea immediately.

usage: Relieves acidity and nausea in patients with reflux disease.
dosage: Usually 1 capsule daily before food. Consult your doctor.
warnings: Avoid in patients with intestinal blockage.

usage: Pediatric medicine for fever and mild pain in infants and young children.
dosage: Dosage strictly as per child's weight and doctor's advice.
warnings: Do not give more than directed.
storage: Keep in a cool, dry place.

usage: Used for management of fever and pain in children.
dosage: As directed by pediatrician. Follow weight-based dosing.
warnings: Ensure correct measuring device is used.
Avoid use with other Paracetamol drugs.

usage: Used for relief of mild to moderate pain and fever in children.
dosage: Follow doctor's prescription strictly. Usually thrice daily.
warnings: Do not use for more than 7 days.

usage: Provides relief from cold symptoms like sneezing and runny nose in children.
dosage: Consult a pediatrician for appropriate dose.
warnings: Do not use in children under 2 years unless specified.

usage: Antibiotic drops for bacterial infections in infants.
dosage: Strictly as prescribed by a pediatrician. Complete the full course.
warnings: Inform doctor of any drug allergies.

usage: Steroid for severe allergic reactions, inflammation, and autoimmune diseases.
dosage: Varies significantly; follow doctor's schedule precisely. Taper as directed.
storage: Keep in a cool, dry and dark place.

usage: Used to treat and prevent nausea and vomiting in children.
dosage: Dose based on weight and age. Consult a pediatrician.
warnings: Inform doctor of any heart or liver conditions.
Watch for signs of allergic reactions.
